# Tooltips answer the keyboard, and Dialogs & Overlays shows them

## Context

#21140's target gives Dialogs & Overlays one new demonstration, Tooltips, and the lane epic #21367 closes only with "each group at the card count of #21140's target". On `dev` `78013b10fc` the group shows the dialog, the toast and the popover, and no folder for a tooltip example exists. No leaf was filed for it.

## The Problem

The lane's rows say it in one line ([the rows](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21142#issuecomment-6980244557)): "`Neo.tooltip.Base` has no example, only button/base's `tooltip` field and grid headers". A visitor who checks whether the engine has tooltips, and what they can carry, finds nothing to open.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/tooltip/Base.mjs`: the tooltip component.
- Tooltips are used inside `examples/button/base` and in grid headers, never as a subject.
- `src/tooltip/Base.mjs` delegates only `mouseenter` and `mouseleave` (Vega's read on this ticket, 22 Nov): a target reached by keyboard shows no tooltip, and Escape does not close one. Focus events already reach the App worker.
- #21605 (closed) fixed a shared tooltip that never hid; the example is where a regression of that kind would show.

## The Fix

**First the engine, in the same pull request:** a tooltip shows when its target receives keyboard focus and hides on blur and on Escape. Content that appears on hover has to be reachable and dismissible without a pointer, and an example cannot show what the component does not do. Then one new example, an app scene and not a row of test buttons: a toolbar and a few records whose targets carry tooltips. It shows a plain tooltip, show and hide delays the visitor can change, rich content (a title, a line of text, a small table or an image), and a target in a second window whose tooltip appears in that window. One line on the first frame says what to hover. The drive is the first step: what `Neo.tooltip.Base` cannot do today (rich content, the second window) is recorded on this ticket and leaves the example's scope as its own engine ticket.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The example shows a plain tooltip, adjustable delays and rich content, each reachable from the first frame.
- [ ] In the engine: keyboard focus on a target shows its tooltip, blur and Escape hide it, a unit spec covers the three, and pointer behaviour is unchanged.
- [ ] The second-window case works, or this ticket names the engine gap and the caption does not claim it.
- [ ] No console error, at 1440×900 and at 390×844 (where a tap shows the tooltip), in every theme its sibling examples offer.
- [ ] A record in Dialogs & Overlays with a caption in the visitor's words and a cover that shows a tooltip open (through `neomjs/pages`).
- [ ] The look: the first frame and a frame with the rich tooltip open, both sizes, Neo Dark, on the pull request, read cold by the reviewer's seat.

**Publication (added 22 Nov, the same for every leaf of this wave).** The criterion above that names this example's record, card, tile or cover in the catalog is met in one of two ways. If #21856 (one catalog file per group) has merged before this leaf's pull request, the pull request carries the record in its group's file. If not, the pull request merges without it: the record stands as text in the pull request body, the cover is merged on `neomjs/pages`, and the catalog entry lands with #21934, the wave's publication pass. Either way this leaf closes with its example.

## Out of Scope

The popover's renewal as a tile. A new tooltip API.

## Avoided Traps

- **A cover without a tooltip.** The cover is the frame a visitor lands on (#21140, ruled 22 Nov), so the example itself opens with one tooltip showing, until the pointer first moves. No capture step hovers anything.

Released: I claimed this at 11:28Z and have not started it. My lane since then is the operator's PRIO 0 on the capture recipes (#21903 / PR #21908) and the catalog split (#21856), so a seat with the hours should take it now rather than wait for me.

One finding for whoever takes it: AC-2 (keyboard focus shows the tooltip, Escape hides it) needs an engine change first. `src/tooltip/Base.mjs` delegates only `mouseenter`/`mouseleave` (`addDelegationRoot`), and nothing in it handles focus or a key. Focus events do reach the App worker (`src/main/DomEvents.mjs` forwards `focusin`; `Neo.manager.Focus` pairs focusout/focusin), so the gap is the tooltip's wiring, not the transport. Per this ticket's own rule, that gap gets its own engine ticket.
